title: World Of Walker
body:
# Walkerworld MC Server
## The official Alan Walker Minecraft Server
**by Checkpoint 1's Aviator Crew**
## Key Features
### Custom Dimensions
- **Walkerworld Hub:** explore many secrets!
- **Survival World:** enjoy the vanilla survival experience and get creative!
- **Shops:** build and open your own Chestshop on a purchasable plot!
- **Events:** join regular exciting events and win prizes!
- **Mob Arena:** Fight custom bosses and mob waves to get powerful loot!
### Alan Walker Experiences
- Register your Walker ID in the ID Room under the Hub
- Rescue your own drone from a Red Nexus Outpost and choose your tribe to unlock unique drone capabilities
- Choose your side: Join the Walkers or Red Nexus
- Explore custom structures from Alan Walker's music videos to find custom loot
- collect all 5 prophecy discs from one of the structures
- get all custom music discs with Alan Walker songs ingame
### Mob Arena:
Complete quests and fight mobs and conquer custom bosses of varying difficulty! Rewards include:
- custom enchantments
- Relic for cosmetics and custom crafting recipes
- powerful weapons
- more custom items
## Check out all features on our website:
https://mc.worldofwalker.com and make sure to read our rules here: https://mc.worldofwalker.com/rules before joining
## About Us
We, the Aviator Crew, are a group of Walkers who enjoy developing custom Minecraft Experiences with pugins and datapacks. No mods required! We are an official team of Alan Walker's Checkpoint 1 Tribe. The server is hosted by Kreatell. More about Aviator Crew here: https://mc.worldofwalker.com/aviatorCrew
